thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED 3 container restarts in pool `gpu-prefill-prod` within 6m. Reason: OOM during prefill stage (CUDA allocation failure). Pager: jessica (oncall).

jessica (oncall): I’m on it. seeing restarts on gpu-worker-12 and gpu-worker-14. Can anyone grab recent pod logs?

raj (eng-sre): grabbing logs from gpu-worker-12 now. snippet: 
```
[2027-10-12T14:03:41Z] runtime: attempting prefill for req id=abc123 token_count=178234
[2027-10-12T14:03:41Z] kv_cache: allocating 22.7 GiB for kv cache
[2027-10-12T14:03:41Z] ERROR: CUDA failed to allocate 24433218432 bytes: out of memory
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Container exited with code 134 -> kubelet restarted container
```

maria (runtime): that token_count header is from the customer payload. runtime tried to pre-allocate based on reported tokens and KV size. Looks like large-context job (context ~180k tokens) triggered huge allocation. current `max_context_tokens` default is 131072.

jessica (oncall): so requests are exceeding our config and runtime doesn't clamp? that's bad. immediate mitigation options?

raj (eng-sre): immediate steps I recommend:
- cordon gpu-worker-12 to stop new pods: `kubectl cordon gpu-worker-12`
- drain non-critical pods off that node: `kubectl drain gpu-worker-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
- bump nodepool by +1 to reduce pressure (scaleset request issued)
- apply Ingress rule to reject requests with X-Token-Count > 150000 as temporary server-side guard

jessica (oncall): doing cordon+drain now. executing scale up.

ops-bot: nodepool autoscaler: scaling request accepted -> +1 gpu node provisioning (eta ~ 3m).

jessica (oncall): patched ingress ACL to drop requests with header `X-Token-Count: >150000` (temporary). applied at edge.

support-liaison: heads-up: Acme Media (dedicated tenant) has been sending few very long-context jobs. their CS rep reported 502s for some requests. tagging customer impact: intermittent errors for large documents, ~15% of their requests that exceed 100k tokens failed in the last 30m.

raj (eng-sre): temporary runtime workaround: push hotfix to abort prefill when observed token_count > soft_limit (soft_limit = 150000) and return 413. prepping PR, will promote canary to 10% first. Patch includes safer KV estimation and defensive check.

maria (runtime): confirming patch will: clamp kv-allocation, avoid allocating > 16 GiB per-gpu for prefill, and fallback to streaming prefill (no huge all-at-once). also adding telemetry metric `prefill_size_bytes` for alerting.

jessica (oncall): after cordon/drain and ingress ACL, restarts dropped to 0 in last 8 mins. system healthy for now. I’m going to notify customer and start handoff to @kevin.

support-liaison: sending customer note now: "We're throttling extreme long-context requests while we deploy a targeted runtime safety patch. No data loss; requests >150k tokens will be rejected with 413 for next ~2h. We will follow up with timeline for a permanent fix."

kevin (oncall-next): I’ll take next shift in 30m. please include checklist in the handoff.

jessica (oncall): handoff checklist:
- confirm no new restarts reported (watch for 10m window)
- ensure bug PR (runtime) merges and canary is observed at 10% without regressions
- validate telemetry `prefill_size_bytes` spikes and create alert if median > 80k
- follow up with infra to add request size enforcement in the gateway (longer-term)
- post-mortem owner: raj/maria

raj (eng-sre): root cause hypothesis: runtime trusted client-reported token_count and used it to pre-allocate KV cache without an upper clamp. combination of very long prompts + token_count header inflated KV size -> CUDA OOM. Also need to verify whether tokenization mismatch caused undercount/overcount.

maria (runtime): agreed. next actions:
1) merge runtime hotfix to abort/clamp prefill (ETA 2h)
2) gateway validation to enforce X-Token-Count and Content-Length limits (ETA 4h)
3) add cgroup v2 memory limits per container to reduce node-wide blast radius (infra ticket created)
4) long-term: add streaming prefill mode and allocator improvements (RFC).

jessica (oncall): leaving the incident as "mitigated" for now. oncall handoff to @kevin in 30m. tagging postmortem required.

kevin (oncall-next): ack, will pick up and monitor. If anything spikes, @raj @maria please page me.

raj (eng-sre): quick note — logs attached show secondaries also logging `cudaMemGetInfo: free=1.9GiB total=24.0GiB` then OOM. We'll add an early prefill memory-reserve check to avoid attempts when free memory < 8 GiB.

maria (runtime): confirmed no more container restarts after mitigation. leaving runtime canary job for the patch.

incident-bot: incident INC-20271012-01 status updated -> mitigated. postmortem requested by jessica.

jessica (oncall): leaving final note: customer impacted but now throttled, mitigations in place, hotfix in progress. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
